products.description:
See and fix your cloud security posture — enable Defender for Cloud, work the Secure Score, and remediate the recommendations that matter.

Cloud misconfiguration is the #1 breach cause, and most teams have no continuous view of it. This solution enables Microsoft Defender for Cloud (foundational + Defender CSPM), turns on agentless scanning and the regulatory-compliance dashboard, and gives you a prioritized remediation program to drive Secure Score up across Azure — and AWS/GCP via connectors.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Enable Defender for Cloud + Defender CSPM and the Secure Score model
  • Agentless machine scanning and the regulatory-compliance dashboard
  • Prioritized recommendation remediation (attack paths, risk hunting)
  • Multicloud connectors for AWS and GCP (posture, high-level)
  • Governance rules, exemptions, and continuous export to workbooks

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A continuous, prioritized view of cloud posture — and a remediation cadence that measurably raises Secure Score instead of a static audit.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • DEFCSPMG-Discovery.ps1 — read-only posture discovery for Microsoft Defender for Cloud: plan
    • DEFCSPMG-Enable-CSPM.ps1 — enable the Defender CSPM (CloudPosture) plan on a subscription
    • DEFCSPMG-Hunt.ps1 — query Defender for Cloud recommendations and attack paths via Azure Resource
    • DEFCSPMG-Report.ps1 — Secure Score + top recommendations report with drift versus a saved
    • DEFCSPMG-Validate.ps1 — confirm Defender CSPM, agentless scanning, provider registration,

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
